name: Asakawa Kouichi
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c45359]Makoto's[/url] classmate, and the first friend he makes. He's easy to talk to, and seems especially considerate of [url=https://vndb.org/c45359]Makoto[/url]. He moved out here from the city a few years ago along with his parents.


Special skills: Isn't afraid of new things (gained out of necessity as he adapted to country life)
Hobbies: Video games, texting (he's written a lot of drafts to his childhood friend, but can't bring himself to send them)
Likes: His childhood friend, cute girls, gossip
Dislikes: Bugs, summer heat, countryside

[Based on translation from the [url=http://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/amatsutsumi/#prettyPhoto]Developer's Site[/url]]
